title: Supabase Lint Allowlist
description: Schema for .github/supabase-lint-allowlist.json. Every accepted Supabase linter finding must be grouped under an architectural category with a substantive justification. Mirrors the runtime checks in scripts/check-supabase-lints.mjs.

level.description: Severity level reported by the Supabase linter for this rule.

category.description: Architectural bucket for this group of suppressions. Must be unique per rule. Use kebab-case.

reason.description: Substantive justification (>= 40 chars) explaining why this bucket is safe. Should describe the authorisation model, guard clauses, or coverage tests that make the finding acceptable.

functions.description: Schema-qualified function identifiers (e.g. public.my_fn). Each function may appear in exactly one bucket per rule.
